title: Indian Navy Receives 6th Stealth Frigate 'INS Mahendragiri' Under Project 17A
summary: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders delivers INS Mahendragiri frigate equipped with MF-STAR radar, BrahMos, and Barak-8 missiles.

blocks.content: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL) delivered **INS Mahendragiri**, the 6th stealth guided-missile frigate under Project 17A (Nilgiri-class), designed by Warship Design Bureau.

provenance.sourceTitle: Indian Navy Receives 6th Stealth Frigate 'INS Mahendragiri' Under Project 17A
